title: Grade Amounts in the Fine Arts Concert Attire Schedule: Grade 6 Credit and High School Formal Wear (Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees)
content:
An attire-level amount is added to the concert attire package of a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03 under **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees**, by the grade on the student's district enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year (Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions): minus 15.00 when it shows grade 06, plus 20.00 when it shows grade 09 through 12, and nothing otherwise.

| Grade on that record | Attire-level amount |
|---|---|
| 06 | minus 15.00 |
| 07 or 08 | nothing |
| 09, 10, 11 or 12 | plus 20.00 |
| no record in status enrolled for the school year | nothing |

Grade 08 and grade 09 sit on either side of the high school boundary: grade 08 adds nothing, grade 09 adds 20.00.
